title: OpenAI API Platform overview
contribution: Responses API is the current direct request path for text, structured output, tools and multimodal workflows; quickstart authenticates with Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY.
boundary: API/model details are time-sensitive and must be capability-checked at deployment.

title: OpenAI API pricing
contribution: Current pricing distinguishes model/token, image/audio and transcription costs, so cloud marginal cost is measurable but model-specific.
boundary: Pricing changes over time and must not be hard-coded into architecture.

title: OpenAI platform data controls
contribution: API inputs/outputs are not used to train models by default; endpoint retention/application-state behavior varies and eligible organizations can configure stronger controls including ZDR.
boundary: Retention and regional-processing eligibility vary by endpoint/account and require deployment-time verification.

title: OpenAI business data privacy
contribution: OpenAI states API business data is not used for training by default and documents encryption and retention-control options.
boundary: Policy/service terms can change and do not remove ActaKit's obligation to record egress and operator policy.

title: OpenAI API current multimodal/audio capability surface
contribution: Current platform documentation exposes vision/multimodal workflows, structured outputs and audio/transcription APIs in the same provider family.
boundary: ActaKit must benchmark exact model snapshots rather than infer equal quality across modalities or models.
